utterances.text: The guinea pigs are Miss Domino
Tribble and Patrick have a pit bull mix
Runt Terrier and a Shih-Tzu Chihuahua mix
a black cat and a white gray Maybe Cages
Well sometimes we'll let them free roam
we have one girl and three boys
all the three boys are together
We have two black and white ones
and I think another brown and white
I take care of the cats
Mom and dad take care of the dogs
I mostly take care of the guinea pigs Whenever they get way too much energy
they will take them out on a walk
I think our pit bull's two years
I don't know how old pipsqueak is Indoor
sometimes I'll take them out for a walk
like a little leash or cat bag
I have one cat who'll jump on anything
I'm just like don't jump on that
make sure can we please go this way
or can you not jump on that
My cat somehow learned how to say my name
so I'll just hear them go
We only have one dog that barks
so We have the play fights and the accidental fights
Our pit bull has a food sharing problem
so we separate them when it comes down to food
It's the year I was born in
I would like how they crunch
